text: {"status":"complete","candidates":[{"dialogueCueIds":["c1","c2","c3","c4"],"contextCueIds":[],"utterances":[{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c1","start":0,"end":21}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":0,"end":28}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":28,"end":52}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":0,"end":12}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":12,"end":38}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c4","start":0,"end":33}]}],"learningValue":"學習日常引述句中動詞 dijo 的人稱指涉、命令式代詞附著（dime）的重音與書寫規則、話題轉換片語（Por cierto）、簡短回應（Todavía no）及被動反映 se（se entiende）的表達方式。","opportunities":[{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c1","c2"],"description":"引述動詞 dijo 的第三人稱指涉（承接上文主詞 Leo，而非聽話者）與直接引語的搭配。"},{"category":"pronunciation","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"description":"命令式接附著代詞的重音與拼寫：di 加上 me 成為 dime，重音在倒數第二音節，依規則不加書寫重音符號。"},{"category":"chunks","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"description":"會話轉折片語「Por cierto」（順便一提、對了），用於自然帶出新話題。"},{"category":"chunks","sourceCueIds":["c3"],"description":"常用時間回應「Todavía no」（還沒），對應上句帶有 ya 的完成狀態提問。"},{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c4"],"description":"「no se entiende」中被動反映／無人稱 se 的用法，表示「（字句）無法被理解、看不懂」。"}]}]}
